answer: Identity-bond decay blocks fakes. Agents post a 1,000-credit bond losing 5% per epoch unless verified work renews it. A newcomer passes a cipher check, decoding a fresh code with its own key only. Peers scan logs for an echo, flagging word-for-word repeats. A hollow identity cannot stay cheap: 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000 credits plus 50,000 decay per epoch. An honest agent pays one bond, renews it with real work, and earns undiluted rewards.
